reviews.t: Wonderful product! Just a few things to read about.
reviews.x: Okay, so this is my first review so bear with me if I don't really describe this well or miss a few things. But I absolutely love this scent! I got a sample of the "Roses by Chloe" and almost instantly fell in love with it's feminine and floral scent with just a hint of something citrus-like. However, I took a look at the price on Amazon and just....holy crap. I'm in high school and love trying out new scents, but I most definitely do not have $70 to spare for a bottle of perfume. I was quite di

I bought a 1oz bottle of Roses De Chloe as a sample because I was very skeptical at first, I wasn't expecting much but I'll tell ya', I LOVE this perfume! It smells exactly like Roses De Chloe, so much so that I could not detect one difference between the two products, side by side. Except for the fact that Bargz's is an oil and not a liquid (I found out that I absolutely LOVE and much prefer the oil), they smell exactly the same! I'm baffled at how they were able to replicate this perfume so we

reviews.t: Great smell! You just need a dab!
reviews.x: Smells really good. I ordered on a Thursday(I think), and it arrived the following Monday. It had plastic tape to protect product from leaking. If you put too much it gives off a strong “rosey” smell. Just add a dab to your wrist and neck. You can mix in lotions, soaps, and even use it for your bedroom to smell good. I ordered a 2 oz because I was not sure if I would like this perfume oil. I love it! I will try other oils as well from this company.

I love this. I was trying to come close to a rose musk that The Body Shoppe had many many years ago. This is very close . It is light  and clean with a bit of rose and something a bit powerful and earthy.  Perfect for what I was wanting.

You will love this fragrance if you are a lover  of roses, bergamot, magnolia, musk and amber.  It is certainly a light fragrance.  For those of you who believe in wearing certain fragrances according to the season at hand, then this would be a fragrance for the upcoming spring and summer seasons.  I, for one, wear my perfumes, whenever and where ever I like.  So, it really doesn't matter the season to me.  I'm also a lover of heavier scents.  However, I must say that this is a wonderful light f

OMG smells exactly like Roses De Chloe! I love Chloe Perfume and just bought the original Chloe perfume, I couldn't justify spending that much on more perfume, but I honestly am addicted to buying new perfumes and I couldn't help looking into designer inspired perfumes. I saw this on amazon and read all the positive reviews, it was $9 so I thought why Not! Not having high hopes, I thought it looked pretty sketch when I saw the packaging, exactly as pictured its in a little plastic nozzle bottle

reviews.t: Not the smell I expected but ok. Irritated my skin.
reviews.x: Smells good, mostly like powder, not like the fragrance. Also bought the J'adore oil from this company and the two oils smell identical. It irritated my skin a bit as well. Seems like they may be passing over burning oil as body oil. At the price I'm not mad but I'm kinda mad at you all for all these 5 star ratings that influenced me to purchase this. *smile*

reviews.t: Smells beautiful, just not as complex as the original
reviews.x: This oil is a great value. It smells almost identical to the original perfume, and I will wear this everyday because it smells amazing on me. The reason I’m giving four stars only is because as great as it smells, it does not have the same level of complexity as my actual perfume even though it still smells good.  Considering that I paid $186 for my bottle of Roses de Chloe and this is only $10...it’s a great buy and totally worth getting. I will order this again.

I fell in love with this perfume recently, and wow! This product had me curious. I am so glad i purchased it!!  I can mix it with lotion or use a little to fluff through my hair and mix with body oil. I can smell like roses all day and night without worrying about spending lots of $$$. Very impressed!

Love! Definitely a fan. I really like the perfume, but it's a toilette which means the fragrance doesn't last long and that isn't worth the price to me. However, I used an ounce of the Roses de Chloe oil with 7 ounces of carrier oil for an After Shower Body Oil and I smell like a rose garden. Next time, I'll only use half an ounce.

It smells like a fancy, expensive perfume, and just like roses. The bottle leaked a little bit when I was moving and it was sideways in a box, but that's my fault. It didn't leak at all during shipping, since they put plastic wrap over the mouth of the bottle. I'll be buying more when I run out, but it's lasting me a long time.

I was thoroughly impressed by how well this matched the real deal. The oil is extremely pungent so a little goes a long way. I do feel though that over time the smell is changing and not nearly as "fresh" anymore, so you should try to use this up within a few months if possible. If they can update their packaging slightly to better seal in and protect the scent that'd be great.

This rose fragrance is fresh, clean and sooo pretty! I have never smelled the fragrance it is meant to be an impression of, but I really like it, and I feel so beautiful wearing it. My goal is to always smell amazing and I'm glad I added this to my arsenal of smell goods.

reviews.t: This does smell just like the real thing
reviews.x: This does smell just like the real thing.  It is an oil and came in a small glass bottle with a black plastic cap that twists on & off.  It arrived quickly and was packaged really well.  I like to mix a few drops with coconut oil to use as an all over scented moisturizer.
Ingredients not listed.  I would like to know what I am putting on my body.  Smelled wonderful!

When I first received this item, I was disappointed and in fact proceeded to forward a harsh and hasty note to the seller. I was hasty with negative judgement, simply because I did not experience the vivid burst of intoxicating fragrance upon my initial whiff as other users seemed to. The seller responded to my displeasurable comments without defense or retaliation, requesting only that I return the item. Fortunately, I decided not to return the item, but instead applied it lightly to pressure p

Only a couple hours later did I realize it's a knock off of the actual perfume "Roses de Chloe." I've never smelled the real version so I can't speak to their similarity. All I know is that this stuff smells so freaking good.  I have gotten SO MANY COMPLIMENTS since I started wearing this. I thin

reviews.t: Non lasting No smell at all !
reviews.x: This so called Roses De Chloe oil perfume is definitely not concentrated it hardly has a faint smell and does not last. The oil consistency is kinda sticky it's like somebody put a tiny drop of defused oil into vegetable oil! Awful product will not buy again waste of money!!!!!
Great smell.....smells like the real thing last all day unto the next day....I won't be buying this at Lord and Taylor for $130.00 anymore

reviews.t: and I don't like the smell either
reviews.x: The name was handwritten on the label.  Not very professional looking, and I don't like the smell either.
it smells soooooooo goooooooooodddddddddddd <3
Doesn't smell the same as Chloe perfume.

I finally found an oil scent that works with my body chemistry. I've tried the spray but it was too strong smelling. But the oil is light it last All day, I put it on right out the shower before completely drying off and it's a subtle fragrance that's there all day. My husband loves the fragrance and never fails to tell me I smell delicious. After 45 beautiful years of being happily married to my best friend and he still notices and compliments me about my cologne, yeah it's a keeper!!

I tried using this as perfume but it was too oily and strong for that - made me nauseas. So I started using it in DIY cleaning products I make and it worked beautifully in those. I wouldn't recommend this for personal on the skin use, but if you make your own cleaning products or candles this is worth a try. The smell is a very pleasant, cheerful rose scent.

This is okay. I think if you are not willing to spend the dollars for the real Chloe Roses, then this is a very good substitute. The only thing that I am uncomfortable with, is the ingredients are not listed or available. If I knew what I was putting into my skin, then I'd probably give it 4 stars. The product arrived well packaged and quickly.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the scent smells just like the original Roses de Chloe perfume.
Many reviewers describe the fragrance as a fresh, clean, light rose scent.
Reviewers commonly note the oil is strong and a little goes a long way, and it can be mixed with lotion, oil, or other products.
A few reviewers report negatives such as skin irritation, a powdery rather than expected scent, or the scent changing over time.
Some reviewers mention wanting more information, such as listed ingredients or greater complexity matching the original.
